name: agrislot-backend
description: AgriSlot - Complete Backend & APMC Mandi Management Platform

scripts.start: [ -e node_modules ] || ln -sfn backend/node_modules node_modules 2>/dev/null || true; node src/server.js
scripts.dev: [ -e node_modules ] || ln -sfn backend/node_modules node_modules 2>/dev/null || true; nodemon src/server.js
scripts.test: [ -e node_modules ] || ln -sfn backend/node_modules node_modules 2>/dev/null || true; NODE_PATH=./backend/node_modules:./node_modules:$NODE_PATH node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: [ -e node_modules ] || ln -sfn backend/node_modules node_modules 2>/dev/null || true; NODE_PATH=./backend/node_modules:./node_modules:$NODE_PATH node --test --experimental-test-coverage tests/*.test.js

author: AgriSlot Engineering Team
